apps.name: ModShelf
apps.subtitle: Steam Workshop downloads on iPhone
apps.localizedDescription:
Download Steam Workshop mods on your iPhone with ModShelf. Sign in to Steam, paste a Workshop link or find mods using the built-in browser.

Downloads are sorted into folders by game. Manage your mods in the library, check for updates, verify files, and export mods as ZIP files. Downloads can even run in a queue.
apps.versionDescription:
ModShelf v1.1 - a new look for the whole app, with download fixes underneath it.

### Changes

- A new look: softer colours, rounder cards, clearer text.
- A tidier library: a clearer header and grouped filters.
- Downloads arrive with the real title and artwork, and blank ones fill themselves in.

apps.name: IPAID
apps.subtitle: Edit IPA bundle IDs, names & schemes
apps.localizedDescription:
IPAID is an on-device utility for editing IPA bundle identifiers, display names, and URL schemes before signing or installing.

Manage app extensions, customize exported IPA filenames, and compare original and exported file sizes.

Useful for SideStore, AltStore, Feather, and LiveContainer workflows.
